The removal must be documented by name: the privacy-egress-removed guide tells users which keys, endpoints, and fields no longer exist.

Recorded session and replay fixtures are released Session data; they contain the historical delivery-accepted watermark and must stay readable (AGENTS.md persistence rules). Composition files under snapshots/ are still checked by the composition rule.

A generated projection of the frozen documentation and persistence catalogs, plus the built VitePress output of that projection; both are regenerated from their sources and both are gitignored build output, so a tree without a built site reports the scope as unverified rather than stale.
